summary: Frontend-only UI/organization pass verified. All role dashboards render, grouped dropdown nav works on desktop (open/close, click-outside dismiss, links navigate correctly) and mobile drawer renders labelled Network/Operations/Insights/System sections. All required data-testids present. No horizontal overflow on desktop 1920px or mobile 390px on tested dashboards. Logout works.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.js is 473 lines; consider extracting getNavItems config, NavDropdown, OutletSwitcher, and MobileDrawer into separate files for maintainability.

The vendor-dashboard testid 'total-revenue-card' collides with the master-dashboard testid of the same name. Consider namespacing (e.g., vendor-total-revenue-card / master-total-revenue-card) to avoid ambiguous Playwright selectors when multiple pages share test infrastructure.
test_credentials: Used provided credentials from review_request; all logins successful.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Master dashboard testids and nav groups (network/operations/insights/system) verified. Mobile drawer emits 8 group labels (uppercase + tracking) — count of 8 due to CSS tracking styles matching regex twice per label; drawer content itself renders correctly. All dashboards verified for testids: master (7 stat cards), corporate (2 stat cards + header), site (4 stats + manage-site-btn), employee (2 stat cards), vendor (3 cards + operator flat links + 2 dropdown groups + outlet-switcher). No 500s. Only 401s were pre-login /me probes (expected).
